title: Baobab
body:
Description

Baobab is a tree-type material found on top of the sandstone pillars in the desert. The trunk is so broad that it can't be filled into Steel Planker, so you need to pick a smaller branch to process it.

To obtain Baobab, you need to either climb the sand pillars or travel into the mountainous area of the Desert.

Min Size: ~1,500 units

Max Size: ~3,500 units
